incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: auth-service token validation errors spike (P1) — pager duty triggered (PD-98512)

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PD-98512 fired for service=auth-service, severity=critical — escalation policy=oncall-sre

Alex Chen (oncall): acked oncall, taking lead. I'm joining Zoom.

Alex Chen (oncall): quick summary from alerts: token-verify errors -> 401s for a subset of tokens, starts 2026-03-15T12:03Z, error rate ~12% on /v1/verify, spike correlated with a key rotation event ~12:01Z.

Jordan R (sre): seeing a bunch of jwks fetch failures in logs: `jwks refresh failed: 504 gateway timeout` then `kid mismatch for token`.

Priya (eng-auth): we rolled out key-roll code at 12:00Z that flips the signing key and publishes to jwks service. It should be backwards compatible using previous key, but logs show some caches didn't pick up previous key.

Linda (support): customer-ops-bot reporting multiple customers on hosted API receiving 401. One high-volume customer reported edge 401s for traffic starting ~12:04Z. Support on thread with them.

Alex Chen (oncall): first action: set severity to P1, notify leadership. Second: disable automatic key rotation and force re-publish of old key to jwks endpoint. Priya, can you push a force-publish?

Priya (eng-auth): on it. Running force-publish now: ```bash
# force push current primary + previous keys
curl -X POST https://internal-auth-control/api/jwks/publish -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"force":true}'
```

Priya (eng-auth): publish done. jwks endpoint shows both keys now: `keys: [kid: "rwd-2026-03-15-a", kid: "rwd-2026-03-14-b"]`

Jordan R (sre): confirming propagation: querying jwks from multiple regions: us-west returned both keys, eu-central still 503 on first attempt but returns OK on retry. CDN purge in progress.

Alex Chen (oncall): temporarily add a verification fallback in auth-service to accept previous JWK if present in local cache. Priya, can we push a hotfix to accept cached key for 30m?

Priya (eng-auth): quick patch prepared. Pushing as canary to 10% of auth instances: ```yaml
# patch snippet
verify: accept_cached_previous_kid: true
cache_ttl: 1800
```

Priya (eng-auth): canary deployed at 12:18Z. Monitoring.

pagerduty-bot: PD note: Incident acknowledged by Alex Chen (oncall).

Jordan R (sre): metrics update: error rate dropped from 12% -> 3% after force-publish and canary. Latency unchanged. Token issuance looks normal.

Linda (support): customer update sent: "We're investigating an authentication issue affecting token verification for a subset of requests. We've implemented mitigations and expect recovery for most customers within 30 minutes. We'll follow up with root cause." :white_check_mark:

customer-ops-bot: high-volume customer postmortem request: customer wants timeline and mitigation; ticket created #C-8721.

Maya Singh (oncall-next): I'm watching metrics and will take handoff in 20m if still active.

Alex Chen (oncall): action list: (1) continue canary to 100% if no regression, (2) purge CDN + ensure jwks propagated to all regions, (3) run synthetic verifies against known tokens, (4) update runbook with extra propagation checks.

Priya (eng-auth): promoting patch to 100% at 12:28Z. Deploy logs: `promote canary -> success`.

Jordan R (sre): CDN purge completed at 12:30Z. jwks fetch success across all regions.

Alex Chen (oncall): monitoring: error rate back to baseline (~0.1%) by 12:35Z. Customer reports decreasing.

Linda (support): posting update to affected customers: recovery confirmed, full status update will follow with RCA.

Priya (eng-auth): immediate root cause hypothesis: clock skew+partial cache invalidation during rapid key-roll caused some edge nodes to validate against rotated key with propagation lag. Working on a small hardening: add overlap window + more robust fallback to previous key for 5 minutes post-rotation.

Jordan R (sre): logs to include in RCA: `auth-verify: token kid x not found in local cache, jwks fetch 504`, `jwks-service: deploy triggered at 12:00Z, propagation delay detected`. Saving artifacts to /incidents/PD-98512/artifacts.tar.gz

Alex Chen (oncall): handing to Maya for follow-up and RCA. Maya — accept the handoff when ready and I'll un-ack.

Maya Singh (oncall-next): taking handoff at 12:40Z. I'll coordinate RCA and schedule post-incident review tomorrow 16:00Z. Please add any notes to the incident doc.

pagerduty-bot: PD note: Incident PD-98512 status -> acknowledged -> owner=Maya Singh.

incident-bot: created incident channel #inc-98512-auth-verify and pinned runbook link https://redwood.internal/runbooks/auth-key-rotation.md

Alex Chen (oncall): de-escalating paging to on-call follow-up. Leaving notes: immediate mitigations = force-publish jwks, canary accept_cached_previous_kid, CDN purge.

Linda (support): final customer message posted at 12:54Z. Customers reporting recovery.

Priya (eng-auth): next steps: schedule safer rotation window with propagation checks, add metrics on jwks fetch latency, add automated verification synthetic tokens post-roll.

Maya Singh (oncall-next): marking in-channel status: monitoring -> stable. Will close incident when RCA doc uploaded. Thanks all. :bow:
